title: Variables and expressions: distinguish expression and equation
metacognition_prompt: Before you start, what single skill is this repair problem checking?

source_reference.notes: Called by Q-001 Q001_WRONG_FINAL_FORM. Atomicity=alg.variables_expressions; Scenario=Called by Q-001 Q001_WRONG_FINAL_FORM; Surface variation=yes; No new vocab=yes; Steps=1-2. Edexcel pivot metadata applied.

problem_text: Which one can be solved for x: x^2 + 5x + 6 or x^2 + 5x + 6 = 0?
student_prompt: Answer this short repair question. Keep your working brief.

error_category_mapping.diagnostic_sentence: If the expression without '= 0' is chosen, the issue is confusing a form to factorise with an equation to solve. IGCSE solve commands require an equation.

hint_ladder.title: Equation test
hint_ladder.prompt: You can solve only when there is an equals sign. An expression can be simplified or factorised, but not solved by itself.

hint_ladder.title: Look for equals
hint_ladder.prompt: Compare the two options and find the one that states something is equal to zero.

hint_ladder.title: Command mismatch
hint_ladder.prompt: A common slip is trying to solve a bare expression because it looks like a quadratic. Solving needs an equation.

hint_ladder.title: Expression/equation routine
hint_ladder.prompt: Before solving, check for an equals sign and a target value. Choose the valid equation here; do not copy.

common_errors: uses the previous larger problem instead of this repair skill
expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: This repair focuses on distinguishing a quadratic expression from a quadratic equation before deciding what operation is allowed.
